subject: Wire exec_start to runGoExecutor in handler_sessions.go
body: Task 44 already implemented the wiring: exec_start calls runGoExecutor(sessionID, ticket.ID, ticket.WorktreePath, database) directly, with the ListTasksByTicket and BuildExecutorPrompt calls removed. The kiro import is retained because plan_complete and replan_ticket still use kiro.FindSessionByCwd, kiro.BuildReplanPrompt, and kiro.Kiro{}. Build verified clean with go build ./...
